text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate (4.8%) and tail latencies > 2s observed for eu-west-1 on model 'mistral-edge-q8_0' starting 1915550000. Auto-escalation to on-call.

maya (oncall): I'm on it. paging raj and emily. seeing customer tickets about timeouts. key: corp-analytics-prod showing the highest error volume.

raj (infra): pulling metrics — looks like sustained request burst from a handful of heavy keys. 95th p95 tokens/sec per-key spike and KV-cache miss rates spiked. Could be a bad batch or a rogue job.

emily (runtime): logs show repeated OOM-ish failures on the quantized path and repeated kernel fallback to slower kernels. stack shows: `runtime::kv_cache::evict: eviction_latency=480ms` and repeated `decode_timeout` entries.

derek (sre): agreed — customer impact visible. Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) emergency per-key throttles on heavy keys, 2) demote the q8_0 experimental variant and steer traffic to stable-mistral-v1, and 3) apply quota for public keys to 30rps while we investigate.

maya (oncall): do it. prioritize low-risk steps first (quotas/throttles) then variant steering if still bad.

emily (runtime): command to set per-key quota (console API):
```bash
# throttle corp key to 40 rps temporarily
redwoodctl keys update --key corp-analytics-prod --rate-limit 40
# set global public key emergency cap
redwoodctl quotas update --scope public --max-rps 30
```

raj (infra): applying throttle to the top 5 offending keys now.

ops-bot: Action: `keys.update` executed by raj. corp-analytics-prod -> 40rps. Keys: corp-analytics-prod, partner-az1, test-ml-batch, dataproc-09, ingest-svc reduced.

maya (oncall): monitoring dashboards... p95 droplets starting to come down from 2.4s to 1.2s in eu-west-1 but 5xx still ~2.2%.

emily (runtime): since errors persist, preparing to demote variant. Proposed traffic change: set weight of mistral-edge-q8_0 -> 0 and shift to stable-mistral-v1 (compatible interface). Command: 
```bash
redwoodctl traffic set --model mistral-edge --variant q8_0 --weight 0 --reason "emergency demotion: high errors/latency"
redwoodctl traffic set --model mistral-edge --variant stable-v1 --weight +100
```
Note: this will cause rolling reroute; expect brief additional load on stable variant.

derek (sre): watch memory and p95 on stable as we move traffic. If stable starts to hit SLOs, we fallback to global quota-only mode.

maya (oncall): do the variant demotion. emily/r aj coordinate.

deploy-bot: Started traffic update.

ops-bot: Traffic policy updated: mistral-edge:q8_0 -> 0% (1915550122). stable-v1 increased by equivalent weight and accepted 97% of rerouted requests.

raj (infra): demotion applied. routing logs show gradual drain of q8_0 sessions. no immediate errors on stable.

maya (oncall): monitoring — eu-west-1 5xx dropped from 4.8% to 0.9% in 3 minutes. p95 now 0.9s. corp-analytics-prod still seeing elevated retry loops but within quota.

emily (runtime): investigating root cause — early indicator: quantized kernel path for q8_0 shows incorrect attention-caching on long contexts causing KV-cache explosion. will run repro on dev infra. created issue INF-3489.

derek (sre): customer-facing mitigation: ops to notify support to send template note to affected customers saying we applied throttles and moved traffic to a stable variant; include expected recovery timeframe ~15-30m.

maya (oncall): done. support notified.

liz (oncall-next): I'm picking up the handoff at 1915550300. current state: throttles in place, q8_0 disabled for production traffic, stable-v1 handling normal load, open investigation INF-3489. No immediate action pending unless errors recur.

maya (oncall): handing to liz. action items for postmortem: 
- runtime to capture failing kernel traces and a minimal repro (emily)
- infra to add per-variant health checks to auto-evict before full failure (raj)
- product/eng to review default variant staging for quantized releases (maya)
- support to list impacted customers and outreach log (derek)

derek (sre): logging incident in pagerduty. severity: SEV2 (customer impact, mitigated).

incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigations applied (throttles, variant demotion). Assigned INF-3489 to emily + raj.

liz (oncall-next): thumbs up. I'll stay on watch for 30m then transition to normal ops.

maya (oncall): thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
